Deathball
20% of base mana
Instant2 min cooldown
Launch 3 Deathballs in a line, increasing in speed the further they travel.

They explode when they come into contact with an enemy, dealing 1026+6.1 Points Per Level+RAP*.35 Fire damage to nearby enemies, increased based on distance traveled.

Bot and Build abilities reduce the cooldown of this ability by 2 sec.
